title: Symlink: Linking Mathematical Symbols to their Descriptions
description: SemEval-2022 Task 12 (Symlink): extracting mathematical symbols and their textual descriptions from scientific documents and linking each symbol to the description it refers to. Annotators mark symbol and description spans, then link them with relation types (Direct, Count, Coref-Symbol, Coref-Description). Documents are drawn from arXiv papers across mathematics, physics, biology, economics, and computer science.
